attributes.name: Portable Ram
attributes.powers: When a character at your location encounters a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, display this card. While displayed, add 1 to checks by characters at you location to defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait. If any character fails a check to defeat a bane, bury this cards; if proficient with heavy armors, recharge this card instead of burying it.
